{{Quote|Then, we're not on any known world?''"<br />"''Princess, this is the kind of sector listed on most star-charts under the heading, 'Here be space-dragons.'|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], stranded on [[Keeper's World]]|<ref name="The Keeper's World" />}}
The '''Sprizen sector''' was a sector located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It bordered the [[Tragan Cluster/Legends|Tragan Cluster]], [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector]], [[Nijune sector/Legends|Nijune sector]], [[Morshdine sector/Legends|Morshdine sector]], [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]], [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]], and [[Corosi sector/Legends|Corosi sector]].<ref name="TEAOC" />
